channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Pony.ai CEO predicts robotaxis will be widespread within five years, saying technology is largely solved
item.description: While Waymo leads in the U.S., Chinese firms like Pony.ai are expanding rapidly in other markets.

item.title: Hunter Biden launches $LAPTOP memecoin, promises 20% reserved for traders who lost on Trump's token
item.description: The move drew criticism on Crypto Twitter, where users expressed fatigue with memecoin-linked 'rug pulls.'

item.title: One-third of EU terror suspects last year were minors as online extremism grows
item.description: EU authorities report that young people are increasingly drawn into online communities where violence becomes a source of status and entertainment.

item.title: Russia and North Korea open first road bridge across their borders, a 'significant event' in transport expansion
item.description: In 2025, nearly 98% of North Korea's external trade was with China, which has at least 17 active road and rail links with the country.
